concepts.def: Louis Daguerre announced process 19 August 1839 in Paris Academy; Niepce's earlier heliograph 1826 first surviving photograph.
1885-1915 movement; Henry Peach Robinson and Alfred Stieglitz's Photo-Secession 1902 sought painterly photographic art.
Group f/64 founded 1932 by Edward Weston, Ansel Adams, Imogen Cunningham; sharp focus, large format, no manipulation.
Walker Evans's Let Us Now Praise Famous Men 1941, Dorothea Lange's Migrant Mother 1936, Sebastiao Salgado's Workers 1993.
Bernd and Hilla Becher's typologies of industrial structures since 1959 led to Andreas Gursky, Thomas Struth, Candida Hofer.
Jeff Wall's lightbox transparencies since 1977; Gregory Crewdson's Twilight 2002; Cindy Sherman's character studies.

walkthroughs.body_html:
Visual Arts in Context — a core area of Art & Design.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Visual Arts in Context brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Visual Arts in Context.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
